papers.title: Enhanced LLM Reasoning by Optimizing Reward Functions with Search-Driven Reinforcement Learning
papers.what: Holds the base model fixed and searches the RL reward function itself: a frontier model proposes rewards, each screened by a short GRPO run and ranked by F1, lifting the best ensemble to F1 0.795 over a 0.609 baseline.

papers.title: Assessing the Operational Viability of Foundation Models for Time Series Forecasting
papers.what: Audits whether large time-series foundation models earn their inference cost, and adds a Complexity Router that sends each series to the cheapest adequate model class for higher accuracy at much lower cost.
papers.builds_on: LLMs for Time Series Survey (Zhang 2024), TS-Agent (Liu 2025)

papers.title: Squeezing Capacity from Multimodal Large Language Models for Subject-driven Generation
papers.what: Conditions a diffusion generator on a multimodal LLM with a Dual Layer Aggregation module that combines features across LLM layers, improving identity preservation in subject-driven image generation.

papers.title: GARD: Geometry-Aware Representation Denoising for Robust Multi-view 3D Reconstruction
papers.what: Runs diffusion-based restoration inside the geometry-aware feature space of a feed-forward 3D reconstructor rather than on raw pixels, recovering accurate structure under degraded real images.
